source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the role of cryptocurrencies (PDF 164).

blocks.text: Cryptocurrencies paisa badalne ka decentralized tareeqa deti hain: bankon ke jaari karne ki bajaye yeh blockchain se transactions aise darj karti hain jo badli na ja sakein, baghair darmiyani ke. Bitcoin, Ethereum waghaira logon ko sarhadon ke paar bhi jaldi aur sasta paisa bhejne deti hain, aur bank tak pohanch na rakhne walon ko shamil kar sakti hain.

Kitab kehti hai ke aisi transactions private hain kyunke zaati maloomat nahi chahiye. Zyada durust yeh ke Bitcoin transaction naam ki bajaye address ke saath ledger par sab ke saamne darj hoti hai, to yeh mukammal private nahi balke pseudonymous hai. Cryptocurrencies ki qeemat bhi tezi se oopar neeche ho sakti hai, aur un ki qanooni haisiyat mulkon mein mukhtalif hai.

blocks.prompt: Cryptocurrencies ka ek faida aur ek khatra bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Faida: bank ke baghair sarhad paar tez aur sasti muntaqili. Khatra: qeematein tezi se badal sakti hain, aur khoyi keys ya dhoke se paisa hamesha ke liye ja sakta hai.

items: Cryptocurrencies: blockchain par decentralized paisa (Bitcoin, Ethereum); shaffaf ledger, pseudonymous, utaar charhao wali.
